career_ladder.note: The Indian Forest Service (IFS) is one of the three All India Services constituted under the All India Services Act, 1951. Officers are allocated state/joint cadres and manage forestry, wildlife sanctuaries, national parks, and environmental conservation. Pay levels follow the central 7th CPC All India Service scale; promotion timescales follow DOPT / Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) guidelines.

exam_scheme.note: The Indian Forest Service Examination consists of two sequential stages. Stage I is a common screening test conducted through the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination (objective, 400 marks). Candidates qualifying Prelims on the basis of GS Paper I marks (subject to achieving the mandatory 33% qualifying threshold in CSAT Paper II) proceed to Stage II: Indian Forest Service (Main) Examination consisting of a written examination (6 conventional papers, 1400 marks) followed by a Personality Test / Interview (300 marks) for a total final merit score of 1700 marks. In Stage I objective papers, a penalty of one-third (0.33) marks is deducted for each incorrect response.

financial_package.estimate_note: Assumes Level 10 entry basic pay (₹56,100) at 58% DA across divisional field postings and state capital headquarters; in-hand pay factors in mandatory deductions for NPS Tier-I and medical/insurance funds.
official_perks: Official residential bungalow / government accommodation within forest division or headquarters
Official 4WD duty vehicle with driver for territorial forest inspections
Medical coverage under CGHS / State AIS Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual uniform / equipment allowances
Field duty allowances and special allowances for designated remote wildlife circle postings
